title: Mildred Bailey, Connie Boswell, Maxine Sullivan and Betty Carter
summary: People say Humes sounds like Mildred Bailey. She liked Connie Boswell and Maxine Sullivan, and first heard Betty Carter when they sang on the same concert several years ago.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them

blocks.x: Well listen there are one or two other singers that we ought to just speak about. One was Mildred (Bailey).
Oh, Mildred Bailey?
